name: 85054 · Phoenix, AZ
findings: ZIP 85054 (Phoenix) has 14 nonprofit organizations. 8 of them (57%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 5 organizations.
Foundation organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (17% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 85054 (Phoenix) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
25% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.
